message.content: Hey, I’m drowning in emails. Can you draft a quick reply to the client for the Stellenbosch wedding shoot? They’re asking about the final delivery date.

content.text: Sure thing. Would you like to keep it professional or friendly? Also, do you want to mention the specific date of the online gallery launch?

message.content: Friendly is fine. Just say it’s next Friday. Oh, and can you check if my gear insurance is still active? I got a renewal notice but I can't find the amount.

content.text: I’ve found the renewal notice. Your gear insurance premium is 800 ZAR. It’s due on the 15th. Shall I schedule a payment reminder for next week?

message.content: Yes, please set that reminder. I’ll pay it when I get back from the studio. By the way, did you update my calendar for my workout? I switched the regular pilates instructor to Sarah Jenkins.

content.text: Done. I’ve replaced your Thursday 7 AM slot with Sarah Jenkins. I also removed the old instructor’s details. Do you need to know her studio location again?

message.content: No, I’ve got that saved. Okay, back to the email. Can you add a line about how excited I am to capture their big day? Keep it short.

content.text:
Here is the draft:

"Hi [Client Name],

Thanks for checking in! I’m absolutely thrilled to be part of your special day in Stellenbosch. The final edited gallery will be ready for you to view next Friday.

Can’t wait to see you there!

Best,
Thandiwe"

message.content: That looks perfect. Send it. Now, help me plan dinner. I have chicken thighs, spinach, and some feta in the fridge. Need something quick because Bongo needs a walk and I’m starving.

content.text: You could make a one-pan baked chicken with spinach and feta. It takes about 30 minutes. Would you like me to pull up a recipe for you?

message.content: Yes, please. And while you’re at it, add lemons to the shopping list if we don’t have any. I need them for the chicken.

content.text: I’ve added lemons to your digital shopping list. Here is the recipe for the chicken dish. Let me know if you need any other ingredients.
